name: Nitta Iroha
source:
The school’s student council President, who is dating the school’s student council Vice President, Tokuda Issei. She is a stubborn girl with a strong sense of responsibility and hates anything that deviates from righteousness. Due to an electoral fraud carried out by some student council members, she was threatened by Tooru into becoming his sexfriend. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=931607]Getchu[/url]]
